messages.subject: WC-00115 - your witness statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mark,

Thank you for your time yesterday. I'm drafting your witness statement now. It will cover: the set-up of the dedicated operation (the 9,000 pallet spaces, 11 operatives, 4 vehicles), the consistently good SLA performance, the unpaid invoices and your chasers to Karen Field, the 9 May termination, and the mitigation steps (vehicle redeployment and Halcyon).

Could you dig out the monthly SLA reports for 2024 and the email chasers to Vantage? They'll be exhibits.

Best,
Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: WC-00115 - your witness statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

No problem. I've found the SLA reports - on-time despatch never dropped below 98.5% and accuracy was above 99.7% the whole time, so their "service failures" line is nonsense. I'll scan the chaser emails to Karen and send them over. They never once complained about service when I was chasing payment.

Mark
